mapper.select: SELECT a.*, b.DICT_TYPE AS dictType, b.DICT_NAME AS dictName, b.DICT_SCORE AS dictScore, b.DICT_DESCRIPTION AS dictDescription FROM BIZ_TEAM_ASS_RECORD a LEFT JOIN BIZ_DEPT_ASS_DICT b ON a.DICT_ID = b.ID ${ ew.customSqlSegment}

SELECT a.ASS_ID AS assId, sum(IF(b.DICT_TYPE = 1,a.REAL_SCORE,0)) AS addScore, sum(IF(b.DICT_TYPE = 2,a.REAL_SCORE,0)) AS minusScore FROM BIZ_TEAM_ASS_RECORD a JOIN BIZ_DEPT_ASS_DICT b ON a.DICT_ID = b.ID WHERE a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND a.ASS_ID = #{assId} GROUP BY a.ASS_ID
